worldcombat.skill.mefirst.summary: Watch one foe for a real offensive start. Borrow a known move still preparing, or answer a newly started registered native contact or projectile. Both attacks still need to land.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.use.1: Answer a recognized native contact or new projectile
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.use.2: Trade a vigil for a stronger response
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.description.0: Locks onto a foe within %1$s blocks and waits for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.description.1: Respond with %1$s times the base attack budget. Copied preparation fits within the foe's remaining preparation; zero-windup attacks receive a same-beat response.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.description.2: Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.patient.on: Patient: vigil ×1.5, far more likely to catch the foe acting, but windup +3 ticks and cooldown ×1.25.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.patient.off: Snap: an almost instant windup and a short cooldown, but a shorter vigil.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.preference.pat: On: vigil ×1.5, much more likely to catch the foe acting, but windup +3 ticks and cooldown ×1.25; off: a short, snappy grab.
Only wait on a foe within this distance; smaller waits only up close, larger chases it down.
When on, the user may leave its post to cut in; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
worldcombat.skill.mefirst.description.st: Only current preparation or a new observed offensive start qualifies. The foe acts normally; past hits never trigger a copy. Registered melee, arrows, tridents and fireballs copy their base contact/flight, without extra explosions or unknown riders. A completed empty vigil costs this move's PP and cooldown; the vigil can be interrupted.
